messages:
maya: quick heads-up — started canary for q6b-int4 variant on a small slice of support_faq prompts. noticing a drop in exact-answer recall vs int8 baseline (~6% absolute). filing here before we escalate.
aj: acked. do we have the eval diff by intent?
maya: yeah gist below. it's concentrated on short, extraction-style prompts (1-3 tokens answer). sample of failcases attached.

samir: can you paste the eval snippet? curious if it's an output tokenization mismatch or a quality drop.
maya: sure — here's the per-intent table from the offline eval (5000 samples, matched seed):

```
intent               | int8_recall | q6b_int4_recall | delta
---------------------|-------------|-----------------|------
support_faq_extract  | 0.87        | 0.81            | -0.06
account_reset        | 0.91        | 0.90            | -0.01
billing_lookup       | 0.84        | 0.82            | -0.02
short_confirmation   | 0.95        | 0.88            | -0.07
```

maya: full diffs + random failed samples uploaded to the dataset bucket. link: https://s3.redwood/curation/q6b-int4/canary-2026-03-21

ciara: hmm that -0.06 on extract is concerning. did quantization change tokenizer behavior (esp punctuation)?
aj: checked token alignments — no shift in codepoints. sounds like quality regressed. could be kernel selection / perf path for short contexts.

label-bot: FYI — existing reference set (refset_v12) contains 220 examples for support_faq_extract; 38 of them are short-answer single-token.

samir: propose we do two quick things: 1) spin a micro-canary that routes only extraction prompts to int8 and q6b_int4 to compare live; 2) create a short focused reference set augment (+200 synthetic short-extracts) and run the eval again.

maya: +1. for (2) we should avoid synthetic style bias. ciara, can you coordinate a small labeling batch to add ~150 human-curated short-extract examples? rough priority: ambiguous punctuation, email/ids, and one-word codes.

ciara: can do. estimated turnaround 48 hours if we cut a batch now. will coordinate with label team to avoid overlap with dedupe queues.

aj: for the micro-canary routing, @deploy-bot can you spawn a canary with 1% traffic for 2 hours targeting the extraction intents only? config: route rules by intent tag `intent:extraction` -> candidate q6b_int4; fallback int8.

deploy-bot: request received. creating canary: name=q6b-int4-extract-canary, window=120m, traffic=1%. will post link once live.

maya: also one more ask — before we add to the reference set, can we run a dedupe check vs refset_v12 and the main promptbank to avoid contaminating with near-duplicates? last time synthetic seeding created overlap and biased recall.

ciara: yes will run fuzzy-hash filter (threshold 0.85) + manual spotcheck of 50 samples. I'll put the job on the curation queue now.

samir: if the micro-canary confirms the regression, we should snapshot kv-cache traces for failing samples and add to a 'regression-captures' folder for debugging kernel differences. also consider flipping kernel flag `use_alt_attention` off for a quick A/B.

maya: agreed. i'll add the capture step to the canary plan.

aj: timeline: canary up in ~10m, ciara labels batch in ~48h, dedupe & synthetic-aug run in parallel. if we see regression persistent after human refset augment, we open a rollback/CQ.

ciara: started curation job: job_id=cur-8942. will comment here when fuzzy dedupe pass completes.

deploy-bot: canary live: https://console.redwood/canaries/q6b-int4-extract-canary (started 4129098775). routing rule attached.

maya: thanks — monitoring logs. will post early canary metrics snapshot in ~30m. :eyes:
